chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali ibn Yaqoub, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from Al-Husayn ibn Musa Al-Hannat, from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'My wife has a sister who is known to be upon our view, and there are not upon our view in Al-Basra except for a few, so can I marry her to the one who does not agree with her view?'
He (peace be upon him) said: 'No, and there is neither a Blessing nor a prestige [nor a distinction].'
Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic is Saying: 'Do not send them back to the unbelievers, neither are these (women) lawful for them, nor are those (men) lawful for them.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a woman to someone of a different religious sect according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, the Imam (peace be upon him) clarifies that the prohibition of sending believing women back to disbelieers (Surah Al-Mumtahanah 60:10) extends to the initial marriage contract, advising against marrying a woman to a 'Nasibi' (sectarian opponent) even if she is well-versed in their view. This ruling underscores the Shia principle of 'Al-Wala' wa al-Bara' (loyalty and disavowal), emphasizing that marital compatibility requires alignment in core religious identity to preserve spiritual integrity. The narration highlights that such unions lack divine blessing (Ni'mah) and distinction (Karamah), reflecting the broader theological context of distinguishing the faithful from their sectarian adversaries.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Yaqoub, from Marwan Bin Muslim, from Al Husayn Bin Musa Al Hannat, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasaar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘My wife has a sister who is known to be upon our view (Wilayah), and there are not upon our view in Al-Basra except for a few, so can I marry her to the one who does not agree with her view (faith)?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, and there is neither a Blessing nor a prestige.
Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying . [60:10] do not send them back to the unbelievers, neither are these (women) lawful for them, nor are those (men) lawful for them’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from ibn Faddal from Ali ibn Ya’qub from Marwan ibn Muslim from al-Husayn ibn Musa al- Hannat from Fudayl ibn Yasar who has said the following:

“This is concerning my question before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of the sister of my wife who is of the same belief as we are; but in Basra very few people believe as we do; if we can give her in marriage to those who do not believe as we do.
He (the Imam) said, ‘No, it is not a bounty or honor.
Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, says, “You must not return them to unbelievers; they (women) are not lawful for them (unbelievers) and they are not lawful for them (women).” [6:10]’”
